faq.title: Image-to-Video FAQ
faq.description: Questions about animating still images in Happy Horse AI.

items.question: What upload modes are available in image-to-video?
items.answer: Happy Horse AI supports a first-frame mode, a first-and-last-frame mode, and a continuation mode based on an existing clip.

items.question: Can I define both a starting frame and an ending frame?
items.answer: Yes. The first-and-last-frame workflow lets you guide the visual transition between the opening and final state.

items.question: Can I continue motion from an existing clip?
items.answer: Yes. The continuation mode is designed for extending motion instead of restarting from a new scene.

items.question: What resolution is available for image-to-video?
items.answer: Happy Horse AI currently supports 720p and 1080p output for image-to-video generation.
